graph.title: LEGO Minecraft 21113 The Cave
notes: Instructions contain two numbered bags: bag 1 builds the cave plus Steve (pp.3-20); bag 2 builds the spider, the grass/TNT section, the chest top-level, torches, bucket and the Zombie (pp.21-35). Pages 36-39 are 'Rebuild Inspiration' (an alternative arrangement of the same bricks) and were not modelled as a separate build.
Pictures only; exact stud-to-stud placement of many bricks is inferred. Each brick is given a joined edge to the piece(s) it visibly sits on; ports are mostly left null.

Element IDs mapped from the inventory page by shape/count: 4211385=brick 2x4, 4211795=2x6, 6037399=2x8, 4617862=2x10, 4565322/4565393/4565388 = 2x2 plates with a single centre stud (dark/light grey/lime), 4211094/4211397 = 2x2 4-stud plates (dark/light grey). Colours in props are approximate.

UNRESOLVED COUNT, kept deliberately: element 4216615 (dark brown long brick). The parts page lists '2x 4216615' directly next to '2x 4211201' (the dark brown 2x4), and the only place either brick is used - the grass-section step 2 parts box on p.24 - shows '2x' + '2x' (four brown long bricks in total, drawn as two shorter and two longer). The graph therefore has 2x 4211201 (c6,c7) and 2x 4216615 (c8,c9). The '4' reported by the checker appears to be the combined total of the two brown long-brick types, not a count the booklet gives for 4216615 alone, so no extra pieces were added (they would have no step to be placed in).

The 'sandwich' sub-assembly (2x2 plate, 4 coloured round plates, 4 light grey round plates, top plate) is built 6 times: red (cave, copy 1), copper (cave, copies 2-3), tan (copy 4) and dark-grey 614126 (copies 5-6) in the grass section. Exact stacking of the 24 grey and 24 coloured round plates is an interpretation.

Spider legs (plate 302326 + handle plate 4535739 + hinge piece 6102782, 4 copies) clip onto the two black T-bars (6104209) inserted into the two side holes (side-hole.1 / side-hole.2) of the black 2x2 brick.

The Spider, Zombie, Steve, the bucket and the loose orange round plate 4157103 are NOT fastened to the cave in the booklet (step 8 on p.35 shows them standing/lying beside it). They are tied to the model only with 'contact' (resting) edges so the graph is connected: Steve on the grass-section plate, Zombie on the lava plate, spider beside the base plate, bucket on the lava plate, orange plate beside the bucket. Contact positions are approximate.

Grass section (bag 2 base) is attached to the cave by its 2x4 brick c1 and the two 2x4 bridging bricks c38/c39 on step 10 (p.30); the chest top-level (d-parts) sits on the three dark stud plates b96/b97/b98 of the cave.
Minifig/figure parts (Steve, Zombie) use new part types because the Minecraft heads/torsos are not in the catalogue.
